name: limberpix
description: Pixel-art sprite animation skills for Claude Code: animate creatures from one drawing and check the motion before anyone sees it.

plugins.name: limberpix
plugins.description: Two skills for pixel-art sprite animation: pixel-animate (a method to animate creatures from one drawing, with a body-part cutter) and pixel-anim-check (a measured check for broken motion, with a contact sheet and GIF).
